rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something in a provocative manner.

example.english: They spoke provocatively, making everyone at the table fall silent.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢挑釁咁，搞到成枱人都唔想出聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 tiu1 jan6 gam3 gaau2 dou3 seng4 ci4 jan4 dou1 m4 soeng2 ceot1 seng1

rows.note: Use this when the provocative behavior is aimed at challenging or provoking someone.

example.english: They kept looking at me provocatively, as if waiting for me to make the first move.
example.traditional: 佢一路挑機咁望住我，好似等我出手咁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 lou6 tiu1 gei1 gam3 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 hou2 ci5 dang2 ngo5 ceot1 sau2 gam3

rows.note: Use this when the provocative behavior is specifically intended to start an argument or fight.

example.english: They taunted the other side provocatively outside the stadium, and nearly started a fight.
example.traditional: 佢喺球場門口撩交嗌咁挑釁對方，差啲就打起上嚟。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 kau4 coeng4 mun4 hau2 liu4 gaau1 aai3 gam3 tiu1 jan6 deoi3 fong1 caa1 di1 zau6 daa2 hei2 soeng5 lai4
